items.name: Integrated Advanced Nano-edge Rapier
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

The edge of this precision-crafted foil is sharpened to the thickness of a single atom, using regenerating nanites to maintain itself after countless strikes.

items.name: Integrated Advanced Semi-Auto Pistol
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

This pistol automatically ejects used cartridges and loads new ammunition after every shot fired.

items.name: Shirren-eye Rifle
items.description:
Upgrades: 1

This sniper rifle comes with a compound technological scope that allows snipers to adjust focus and magnification with natural eye movements instead of using moving parts that might disrupt their aim.

defensiveAbilities.name: Accelerated Response
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The target of the elimination-class assassin robot's Target Tracking attempts a Strike against the robot

Effect The robot reads its target's movements, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Burn Protocol
defensiveAbilities.description: The circuitry of an assassin robot self-destructs upon the robot's destruction, making tracing its owner extremely difficult. Add 10 to the DC of a Computers check to recover data from a destroyed assassin robot.

offensiveAbilities.name: Holographic Camouflage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per hour

Effect The elimination-class assassin robot becomes invisible for 10 minutes. If the robot uses a hostile action or moves more than half its Speed in a single action, the robot becomes visible again after it completes that action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Nanite Surge
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The elimination-class assassin robot restores 45 Healing Damage Hit Points to one technological creature or item.

offensiveAbilities.name: Retractable Weapons
offensiveAbilities.description: The elimination-class assassin robot can Interact to draw or retract any of its integrated weapons as a free action. An observer must succeed at a DC 40 Perception check to notice a retracted weapon.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The elimination-class assassin robot's Strikes deal an additional 3d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Target Tracking
offensiveAbilities.description: The elimination-class assassin robot establishes a target lock on a creature it can see within 120 feet. The creature can't become Concealed against the robot or Create a diversion against the robot. This ability lasts until the robot loses line of sight with the target or the target otherwise becomes hidden.
